title: Green Streak Continuation
summary: After at least n consecutive green sessions, how often the next one closed green as well — the streak extending one more session. The denominator is sessions immediately preceded by a green run of length n or more; the numerator is the ones that closed above their open. Read it against the baseline green rate and against streak-reversion: continuation above baseline and reversion above baseline cannot both be true on the same data.

params.name: n
params.doc: Minimum length of the preceding green streak.

deltas: one parameterized query replaces a table of fixed streak lengths
the same definition drives reversion and continuation, so the two are directly comparable
N + 95% CI + stability split on every number
